back: Enquiry → quotation/price list/catalogue → order → (pro forma invoice) → advice note → delivery note → invoice → debit/credit note → statement → payment and receipt.
Seller's bill: goods supplied, prices, trade discount, terms of payment and total due.
Invoice sent before the goods, for payment in advance, as a quotation or for an import licence.
Debit note increases the amount owed (undercharge). Credit note reduces it (returns, damage, overcharge).
Monthly summary of invoices, debit notes, credit notes and payments, showing the balance due.
Reduction off the list price for traders buying for resale; encourages large orders.
Reduction for prompt payment within a stated period; calculated after trade discount.
Amount paid = list price × (1 − trade %) × (1 − cash %). Never add the two rates.
Advice note is sent ahead to say goods are coming; delivery note travels with the goods and is signed on receipt.
